metadata.source: Positive Plan for Corby v9.3 and its film series (Oct-Dec 2026). Routes traced along existing roads and paths with Mapbox Directions and simplified; new links sketched by hand and marked approximate.

properties.name: Corby West Sustainable Urban Extension
properties.desc: About 4,500 new homes are planned here, on Corby's western side. The plan says the GP places, school places and roads must be agreed at the same time as homes like these, not years later.
properties.note: Outline is approximate. It follows the site boundary on OpenStreetMap; check the council's allocation before quoting it.

properties.name: Corby town (its four council wards)
properties.desc: Corby's four town wards: Corby West, Kingswood, Lloyds & Corby Village, and Oakley. The Greater Corby Growth Area is the town plus the 14 parishes around it.
properties.note: Ward boundaries: ONS, May 2025. Shown when the parish boundaries can't be loaded live.

properties.name: Weldon
properties.desc: Weldon is one of the 14 parishes the plan puts in the Greater Corby Growth Area. Bus today: A bus most days. The plan: every village around Corby served at least three days a week by 2030, and daily by 2035.
properties.note: Bus service from published timetables, September 2026.

properties.name: Rushton
properties.desc: Rushton is one of the 14 parishes the plan puts in the Greater Corby Growth Area.

properties.name: Priors Hall Park
properties.desc: Part of the North East Corby growth area, already being built. The plan asks for 30% affordable homes to be enforced, not waived, on schemes like this.

properties.name: Weldon Park
properties.desc: New homes east of Weldon, part of the North East Corby growth area already under way.

properties.name: Willowbrook Health Complex
properties.desc: Grow Willowbrook into Corby's health campus: a midwife-led maternity unit, consultant-led outpatient clinics and a day-case unit, building on the urgent care centre and Community Diagnostic Centre already here. It does not propose an A&E.

properties.name: East Corby Health
properties.desc: A new health centre earmarked near Weldon and Priors Hall, designed to grow with the new estates.

properties.name: Kettering General Hospital
properties.desc: Where almost all Corby's hospital care happens today, and where every Corby birth takes place. Moving care that doesn't need a hospital to Willowbrook leaves Kettering more room for care that does.

properties.name: Tresham College, Corby campus
properties.desc: A retention programme with Tresham College and Corby's secondary schools, with help with travel and kit, so more young people finish the course they start at 16.

properties.name: Northern Orbital Road: existing section
properties.desc: Existing roads from the A43 along Steel Road to Eddington Way. Step one: finish Eddington Way.

properties.name: Northern Orbital Road: new link
properties.desc: A new road west from Eddington Way, round the north of the Earlstrees Industrial Estate, to the A6003 at Rockingham Hill. It would take lorries between the A6003, the industrial estates and the A43 off town streets. The ask now is a funded feasibility study, with Rockingham Parish Council given an equal say on the route.
properties.note: Route is indicative. A feasibility study would set it.

properties.name: A6003 dualling: Rockingham Hill to Fourways
properties.desc: Longer-term: dual the A6003 between Rockingham Hill and the Fourways roundabout.

properties.name: A43 dualling: Weldon to Deenethorpe
properties.desc: Longer-term: dual the A43 from Weldon to just before Deenethorpe, as a first step towards dualling to the A1.

properties.name: A427 improvements towards the A6
properties.desc: Improve the A427 west towards the A6 at Market Harborough, including a bypass for Dingley.

properties.name: Dingley bypass
properties.desc: A bypass to take A427 traffic out of Dingley.

properties.name: West Corby bypass
properties.desc: A bypass around the planned Corby West development, linking the A6003 to the A427.

properties.name: Caldecott bypass (Rutland's scheme)
properties.desc: A bypass for Caldecott on the A6003. This is Rutland County Council's scheme; the plan supports it.

properties.name: St Luke's Road to Long Croft Road link
properties.desc: A short new road giving Little Stanion a second way in and out.

properties.name: Bus priority on Oakley Road
properties.desc: Bus priority on Oakley Road, so buses aren't stuck in the same queues as cars.

properties.name: Bus priority on Rockingham Road
properties.desc: Bus priority on Rockingham Road, one of the main routes in and out of town.

properties.name: Exeter estate: bring the bus back
properties.desc: A bus loop round the Exeter estate along Burghley Drive and Cecil Drive.

properties.name: Bus interchange at Corby station
properties.desc: Move the bus interchange to the station entrance, so trains and buses connect.

properties.name: Cycle path: station, Oakley Road, Westcott Way, Cottingham Road
properties.desc: Today's cycle path, including the £8.59m station link to the town centre that opened in 2025.

properties.name: Cycle path: Phoenix Parkway to Steel Road
properties.desc: Today's cycle path down Phoenix Parkway.

properties.name: Council cycling plan: A427 west to Cottingham, Middleton and East Carlton
properties.desc: A route already in North Northamptonshire Council's cycling and walking plan.

properties.desc: A route already in the council's cycling and walking plan.

properties.desc: A route already in the council's cycling and walking plan.

properties.desc: A route already in the council's cycling and walking plan.

properties.name: Council cycling plan: south to Stanion
properties.desc: A route already in the council's cycling and walking plan.

properties.name: Council cycling plan: along the A43 to Magna Park
properties.desc: A route already in the council's cycling and walking plan.

properties.name: New route: town centre to Willowbrook East via the Pen Green bridge
properties.desc: From the town centre along Pen Green Lane, over an upgraded Pen Green bridge, then down the Phoenix Parkway path to the thousands of jobs at Willowbrook East.

properties.name: New route: southern estates to Little Stanion via the Flinders Close bridge
properties.desc: From the town centre through the southern estates to the Flinders Close bridge, made fully accessible, then a new path to Long Croft Road and on to Little Stanion. Little Stanion Parish Council would be a named consultee.

properties.name: New route: Long Croft Road to the station via St Luke's Road
properties.desc: A link from Long Croft Road along the St Luke's Road path to the station.

properties.name: New route: Oakley Vale to Tresham College and the station
properties.desc: A safe route from Oakley Vale to Tresham College and Corby station.

properties.name: New route: Rockingham Road corridor
properties.desc: A segregated cycleway along the Rockingham Road corridor.

properties.name: New route: Weldon Road greenway
properties.desc: A greenway along Weldon Road between Corby and Weldon.

properties.name: Pen Green bridge: upgrade first
properties.desc: One of two gateway crossings to fix first. It opens a safe route from the town centre to Willowbrook East.

properties.name: Flinders Close bridge: upgrade first
properties.desc: The second gateway crossing: a fully accessible bridge between the southern estates and Little Stanion.

properties.name: Corby to Kettering and London
properties.desc: Almost every train from Corby runs this way, south to Kettering and London.

properties.name: North to Oakham and Melton Mowbray
properties.desc: The line north over the Welland Viaduct to Oakham and Melton Mowbray. The plan wants a regular service this way.

properties.name: Manton to Stamford and Peterborough
properties.desc: The line east through Luffenham to Stamford and Peterborough. Today Corby trains can't reach it without reversing.

properties.name: Welland Valley Rail: 3.5 miles of new track
properties.desc: About 3.5 miles of new track from Seaton to a new station at Luffenham would open the line east to Stamford and Peterborough, giving Corby trains in three directions.

properties.name: Corby station: second platform into use
properties.desc: Passenger numbers rose from about 66,000 in 2020/21 to over 560,000 in 2024/25, on one platform with 60 parking spaces. First: bring the second platform into use with step-free access, and add at least 200 parking spaces and secure cycle parking.

properties.name: New station at Luffenham
properties.desc: A new station where the Welland Valley Rail link meets the line to Stamford and Peterborough.

properties.name: Kettering station
properties.desc: A station on the lines the plan wants Corby trains to reach.

properties.name: Pen Green Lakes Country Park
properties.desc: The largest green space within walking distance of Corby's northern and central estates, and it has no formal protection of any kind. The lakes also hold back flood water from much of northern Corby. The plan: protect it as a country park in the new Local Plan, keep it in public or community hands, with its flood role written into policy. Indicative cost: £3m to £8m.

properties.name: Willow Brook: restored and naturalised
properties.desc: Restore stretches of the Willow Brook, Corby's own river, which runs out through Weldon and Deene to the Nene.

properties.name: Willow Brook: restored and naturalised
properties.desc: Restore stretches of the Willow Brook, Corby's own river, which runs out through Weldon and Deene to the Nene.

properties.name: East Carlton Countryside Park
properties.desc: An existing country park, west of Corby.

properties.name: King's Wood Local Nature Reserve
properties.desc: Existing ancient woodland nature reserve in the middle of the town.

properties.name: Great Oakley Meadow Local Nature Reserve
properties.desc: An existing meadow nature reserve by Great Oakley.

properties.name: Green wedge: Corby and Rockingham
properties.desc: Keep firm green gaps between Corby and the villages around it, so they stay villages.

properties.name: Green wedge: Corby and Weldon
properties.desc: Keep firm green gaps between Corby and the villages around it, so they stay villages.

properties.name: Green wedge: Corby and Little Stanion
properties.desc: Keep firm green gaps between Corby and the villages around it, so they stay villages.

properties.name: Rockingham Forest: country park status
properties.desc: 50,000 new trees across Greater Corby by 2035, and a Nature Recovery Plan for Corby under the Rockingham Forest framework that twelve neighbouring parishes have already started.

properties.name: Lodge Park: warm homes first
properties.desc: Council homes insulated fabric first, starting with the oldest stock and worst conditions. Lodge Park, West Lloyds, Beanfield and Danesholme are the likely first list.
properties.note: Marker shows the estate, not exact homes.

properties.name: A revived Saturday market
properties.desc: A revived Saturday market with a permanent home in the town centre, plus a support fund for independent shops.

properties.name: The Core at Corby Cube
properties.desc: An annual Corby arts festival, built on the UK Town of Culture bid whatever the result: anchored by the Core at Corby Cube, but held across the whole town, with paid roles and training for local people.

properties.name: Elizabeth Street: Corby's last police station
properties.desc: Corby has had no police station since Elizabeth Street closed in 2017. The plan's three tests: a staffed front desk open evenings and weekends; a response unit based in Corby, not Kettering; and a named PCSO for every neighbourhood.
properties.note: Marker shows the street, not the building.
